413-1981-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
413-1981-4476.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Answered Prayers trigger.
Resolve the Answered Prayers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

512-5457-5475.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-5457-5475.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5457-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-2292-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2292-4616.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

141-1854-2292.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-2292.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-969-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

5276-5332-6524-8095.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-3899-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-3899-7188.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

5660-6441-6462-7368-7824.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2082-2099-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2082-2099-3490-7426.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5551-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5551-6797.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat from step 4.

1887-2793-3921-5089-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

488-874-1492-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Delif's Cone or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-874-1492-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1799-4659-5359-5497.description:
Activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

413-2091-4558-5913.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Mana Geyser, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Mana Geyser from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat.

2452-3249-4616-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Harnfel by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Harnfel ability, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them this turn.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

428-1692-3090-5096.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-3090-5096.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2381-4067-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Lore Weaver by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

97-851-2034-2308.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-851-2034-2308.description:

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Araumi does not have summoning sickness.

1056-2085-4639.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling another card from your graveyard for each opponent you have, giving Kelpie Guide encore until end of turn.
Activate Kelpie Guide's encore ability by paying {2}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Activate a Kelpie Guide token's first ability by tapping it, targeting another Kelpie Guide token.
The Kelpie Guide token triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping the other Kelpie Guide token.
Repeat from step 3.

Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-186-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

1134-1267-3297-3395.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai and Preeminent Captain does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Preeminent Captain and Medomai.
1134-1267-3297-3395.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Soldier" on Preeminent Captain to "Sphinx".
Declare Preeminent Captain as an attacker.
Preeminent Captain triggers, putting Medomai from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Medomai to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat from step 2.
